description: Shop payload in window.shops: English audio or subtitles only (with the accent quirk: 'Inglés' does not count); audio/subtitle normalisation; booking URL from the shop template by replacing three %s in order (also when the template holds %20); no URL when the template has no shop_url or not exactly three %s; unknown shops and junk entries skipped; one film in three shops merged by imdb_id.
